description: Return the website checkout link for a get_quote quote, including that quoteId and its payment totals. Pass quoteId to reuse that quote. Without quoteId, reuse the newest unexpired quote for the same stay, or store one quote if none exists. Optional guestName and guestEmail are added to the link only and are not stored. Payment and identity verification happen on the website. This tool does not take payment or an identity document. The link does not reserve dates.

checkIn.description: Check-in date as YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles.

guestEmail.description: Optional guest email. Added to the booking link only. Not stored on the quote.

guestName.description: Optional guest name. Added to the booking link only. Not stored on the quote.

petCount.description: Dogs or cats, 0 to 2. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

quoteId.description: quoteId from get_quote. Reuse that quote when it is still current.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get a website booking link
